column1: # GWRecomp: SHA-256 of the language-dependent speech files of Gene Wars 1.1 for the six languages of the European
# CD (GAME/SPEECH/<ENG|FRE|GER|ITA|SPA|SWE>/*.SPE, which the installer copies to SPEECH/). Hashes and file names only.
# Appended to the install manifest at build time, so an installation in any of these languages is accepted.
